spec.splits: v1 grouping/bucketing recipe, seed 42, five folds, validation=(test+1) mod 5

encoder_model.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
encoder_model.documents: no prefix, CLS pooling, normalized, max_length 256 (configs/v4/dense_arctic_xs.yaml)
encoder_model.chosen_by: rule fixed before running (results/encoder_comparison.json): highest OOF H* on programmers/unix, cheaper encoder wins within 0.005; arctic_xs_q H* 0.4133 at 8.7 ms median encode vs bge_small_q 0.4018 at 15.9 ms and MiniLM 0.3146 at 8.8 ms

gate.features: 21 v1 BM25/query features + 7 QPP features, all computed from the BM25 list
gate.normalization: each domain standardized by the mean/std of its own query features (no labels); on a new domain these statistics come from all of its queries
gate.trained_on: the six seen domains pooled; weights fixed, never refitted on a new domain

tiers.forced_to_h_star: queries with no BM25 token or only OOV tokens

routing.operating_budget_rule: smallest budget >= 0.3 whose LODO development macro is within 0.005 of H* (dev: 0.8 -> 0.4043 vs H* 0.4088)
routing.thresholds: per fold and domain, the gate-score quantile of that fold's train+validation queries (unlabeled) that encodes the operating budget; test queries above it go to H*, others to P*
routing.matched_budget_rule: every scorer (gate v2, BM25-margin, random) routes exactly the same number of test queries per fold (forced queries plus top scores, ties by query ID)

spec.baseline_pe_gh_v1: PE-GH v1 unchanged: MiniLM (sentence-transformers/msmarco-MiniLM-L6-cos-v5, 14ca9be4bbcf1402eac0f43a2e2ccb6e0f994ba3), 21 v1 features, v1_ridge gate on the hybrid gain, H*/S* and the C6 threshold selected per fold on the new domain's own labeled train/validation rows (v1 sees in-domain labels; v2 does not)

analysis.metric: nDCG@10 per query, equal-weight macro over the six new subforums
analysis.multiplicity: Holm step-down over K1-K4 at family-wise alpha 0.05 (one-sided bootstrap p-values)

hypothesis_tests.K1_gate_v2_beats_bm25_margin_matched: at 50% encode budget, P*->H* routing by gate v2 beats routing by the BM25-margin rule (dev LODO +0.0105, 95% CI [0.0061, 0.0148])
hypothesis_tests.K2_pe_gh_v2_noninferior_to_h_star: PE-GH v2 at the operating budget (80%) is non-inferior to always-encode H*, margin 0.01 (dev LODO -0.0045)
hypothesis_tests.K3_pe_gh_v2_superior_to_pe_gh_v1: PE-GH v2 at the operating budget beats PE-GH v1; this is the whole-system upgrade (encoder + tiers + gate) and is driven mostly by the encoder, not by the gate
hypothesis_tests.K4_gate_v2_beats_random_matched: at 50% budget gate v2 beats the 30-seed random router (dev LODO +0.0195)

secondary_reported_without_claims: full budget curves 0.1-0.9 for gate v2, BM25-margin, random and the per-query oracle
realized encode ratio of the quantile thresholds; per-domain results
ROC AUC of gate v2 and of BM25-margin for predicting BM25 failure
static BM25, dense, P*, H* (arctic) and MiniLM dense/H* per domain; PE-GH v1 dense ratio
online latency of PE-GH v2 vs H*, R*, P*, PE-GH v1 and BM25-margin on programmers/unix with gates trained without the measured domain (seen domains, not part of this test)
spec.negative_results_policy: every hypothesis is reported whatever the outcome; no gate, feature, encoder, tier, threshold, budget or margin change after any new-subforum file is read
